audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer row said Skill while content win[0..6] and the packet chart say Ekko on all seven.
audit.why: Ziggs has no dash and one self-knockback on a 20s cooldown, against Phase Dive at 9s and Chronobreak as insurance — there is no stage where he holds the lane.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides set to Ekko, ratings raised, and the first five whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row gave no reason tied to either ultimate.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s of telegraphed zone damage with no escape attached, while Chronobreak lets you commit through it.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the 120s ult and the dive-through pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Satchel Charge knocks YOU away as well as him, or that Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank.
audit.why: The knockback is what breaks a dive mid-commit, and the flat E cooldown is the real gate on stepping in, not the W.
audit.corrected: Both added to breakdown.cooldowns, phases[3].why and the don'ts.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge 20s->12s, Hexplosive Minefield flat 16s, Bouncing Bomb 6s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their titles with Phase Dive's and Chronobreak's real cooldowns.

edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5 — his only escape, and it knocks you away mid-dive. - Hexplosive Minefield: a flat 16s slow. - Bouncing Bomb: 6s at rank 1. - Mega Inferno Bomb: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Phase Dive is only 325 range and 9s at rank 1 — it is the whole gap-close, so never step up to him while it is down.

edits.before: Ziggs spends Satchel Charge early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Chronobreak undoes the trade you lost — dive first, then rewind the whole bill away.

edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you away mid-dive — bait it out first.

edits.before: The rewind heals off the hologram's path — diving away from your own past is how Ekkos die with R up.
edits.after: His Q bounces at 850 on a 6s cooldown — trading in that band before level 3 is pure chip against you.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 and 50s at rank 3 — hoarding it wastes the insurance that pays for every dive.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by mining your approach, bouncing bombs in from 850, and satchel-hopping out the moment you commit.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry by hunting him in side lanes — one escape on 20s, and Phase Dive plus the W stun beats it every time.
